items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh yeah, I played with Paggio I played with Paggio many times at Budweiser

ctx.x: I don't know either What about Paggio? You said you played with them, huh?
Oh yeah, I played with Paggio I played with Paggio many times at Budweiser Many, many jobs at different places That's the thing Who was at the Budweiser?
Yeah I played with Paggio at the Budweiser We didn't have no reggae, don't have five pieces
